remarks: Exceptional five-bedroom residence set in a highly desirable in-town location. This meticulously cared-for home delivers comfort, style, and versatility at every turn, featuring a freshly painted interior (2026) and new recessed lighting in both the formal living room and family room. The chef's kitchen flows seamlessly into a generous family room and out to a welcoming patio and secluded backyard-ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Thoughtfully curated landscaping features outdoor lighting, a built-in grilling station, fencing, and gated driveway. Additional highlights include a sun-filled second-floor family room and a third-level retreat offering flexible playroom or office space with an adjacent guest suite. Custom millwork, abundant closets and storage, a striking rear staircase connecting the kitchen and mudroom, and a spacious unfinished basement with 10-foot ceilings-approximately 1,500 square feet-complete with a Foresight-powered golf simulator round out the offering. An exceptional, turnkey home with an impressive array of premium features.
